title: Free-text recommendation with ask --recommend-text
lead:
`adj ask` can recommend only one of the option labels (docs/json.md: the
recommendation `label` is one of the option labels). During S17, C26 had to
gain a fourth option just to carry its recommendation.
findings_note: S17 dogfood friction (4), note on S20; C167

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S17 dogfood friction item 4. The owner chose `--recommend-text` (C167).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/model/record.go`: store a recommendation with no option label (the field name is the implementer's call); Validate accepts it and still rejects a label that is not an option.
- `internal/cli/ask.go`, `internal/commands/ask.go`: `--recommend-text TEXT`, exclusive with `--recommend`; `--reasoning` works with either.
- `internal/render/*`: `inbox`, `show` and `check` display it.
- `internal/lint/lint.go`: no finding for a free-text recommendation; the existing finding for a label that is not an option stays.
- `docs/json.md`: the new field in `Keys of a record` and in the inbox/show examples.
- Tests next to each changed file; a lint fixture under `internal/lint/testdata`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestAskRecommendText`: the record stores the text with no label; `show`, `inbox` and their `--json` forms display it.
- `TestAskRecommendExclusive`: `--recommend` together with `--recommend-text` is a usage error.
- `TestDecideTextAfterRecommendText`: `decide ID --text ... --why ...` accepts it, as today.
- A model test: Validate accepts a text-only recommendation and still rejects an unknown label.
- `TestJSONShape` (`internal/cli/jsonshape_test.go`) covers the new field.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- An existing record without the new field reads and writes byte for byte as before (run the store and file tests over the current fixtures).
- Keep store.IsStaleCopy (C163) comparing the recommendation as a whole, including the new field.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- `adj lint` on a copy of `decisions/` reports nothing new.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree `.worktrees/s28` on branch `s28`. Commit and land on local main when
the owner asks; no AI attribution.
